title: Number the non-blank lines
description: A text consists of lines separated by newline characters (a single "\n" between two lines; the text may start or end with one, which makes an empty line there). Prefix every non-empty line with its number followed by a dot and a space ("1. ", "2. ", ...), where the numbers count only the non-empty lines, starting at 1. Empty lines stay empty and are not counted. The line structure is kept exactly: the result has the same number of newline characters as the input, and the empty text stays empty.
notes: Empty lines are kept but do not advance the counter; a trailing newline leaves a trailing empty line. A line holding only a space is not empty.
